# Elijah Obeys the Ravens (1 Kings 17:6)

## Emotional Focus
Obeying God even when the answer is surprising.

## Key KJV
“And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening.” (1 Kings 17:6)

## Gentle Retelling
God told Elijah to hide by a brook. Elijah obeyed, and black birds brought him food every day. God took care of him.

## Coloring Prompt
Elijah sitting by a stream while friendly ravens bring bread.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Obey God and watch Him take care of you in surprising ways.”
